Sandshrew

Ground

Kanto · Generation 1

Sandshrew is a Ground-type Mouse Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 12 kg. It evolves into Sandslash. Its highest base stat is Defense (85), with a base stat total of 300.
